figures.name: Nana (Sogdian)

ability.name: Silk Road Queen
ability.description: Control trade routes; double all resource generation and prevent enemy resource gain for 1 turn.

figures.description: The supreme goddess of the Sogdians, depicted with multiple arms and attributes, combining the functions of moon goddess, war deity, and fertility.

figures.name: Ahura Mazda (Sogdian)

ability.name: Divine Fire
ability.description: Purify all allied cards; remove dark influences and grant +2 to all stats.

figures.description: The supreme Zoroastrian deity as understood in Sogdian syncretism, lord of light and truth, whose fire was maintained in Sogdian temples.

figures.name: Siyavash

ability.name: Innocence Through Fire
ability.description: Ride through fire unharmed; prove innocence and gain +3 to all stats permanently.

figures.description: The Iranian prince who proves his innocence by riding through fire unharmed, then is martyred, becoming a beloved figure in Sogdian art.

figures.name: Rustam (Sogdian)

ability.name: Champion's Blow
ability.description: Deal 12 damage to one target; no card can withstand the champion's full strength.

figures.description: The great Iranian-Sogdian hero of the Shahnameh, whose strength is without equal and whose story was painted on Sogdian palace walls.

figures.name: Merchants of Samarkand

ability.name: Silk Road Network
ability.description: Connect all allied cards in a trade network; each gains +2 to their weakest stat.

figures.description: The legendary Sogdian merchants who dominated the Silk Road trade routes, establishing colonies from China to the Mediterranean.

figures.name: Varahran (Bahram)

ability.name: Twelve Forms
ability.description: Cycle through twelve forms; choose the form that grants the stat boost needed most.

figures.description: The Zoroastrian god of victory and triumph, worshipped intensely in Sogdia, who appears in twelve divine forms.

figures.name: Anahita (Sogdian)

ability.name: River Blessing
ability.description: Purify all water sources; heal all allied cards for 5 HP.

figures.description: The great water goddess and goddess of rivers, worshipped across the Persian world including Sogdia, whose waters bring life and purification.

figures.name: Mithra (Sogdian)

ability.name: Solar Contract
ability.description: Establish a contract both parties must honor; both must fulfill stated actions for 2 turns.

figures.description: The solar deity of contracts and friendship, revered in Sogdian tradition as a guarantor of oaths and a solar guardian.

figures.name: Shapur I (Sogdian art)

ability.name: Roman Triumph
ability.description: Capture one enemy card and use their stats as your own for 2 turns.

figures.description: The Sasanian king whose victory over Roman emperors was celebrated in Sogdian art, representing the triumph of Iranian civilization.

figures.name: Sogdian Dancer

ability.name: Feasting Hall Joy
ability.description: Boost all allied cards with the spirit of celebration; each gains +2 to magic.

figures.description: The dancers depicted in Sogdian palace frescoes, who performed at the great feasts of the merchant lords, embodiments of Silk Road cosmopolitan culture.

figures.name: Fire Temple Priest

ability.name: Sacred Fire Eternal
ability.description: Maintain the sacred fire; all fire-domain allied cards gain immunity to water effects.

figures.description: The Zoroastrian fire priests of the Sogdian temples, who maintained the eternal flames and performed the rituals of purification.

figures.name: Afrasiyab

ability.name: Turan's Might
ability.description: Represent the great rival power; deal 8 damage to any Iranian-mythic card.

figures.description: The king of Turan and great enemy of Iran in the Shahnameh, whose battles with the Iranian heroes shaped the Sogdian understanding of cosmic conflict.

figures.name: Feridun

ability.name: Tyrant's Fall
ability.description: Defeat the greatest evil; deal 12 damage to the highest-powered enemy card.

figures.description: The great Iranian hero who defeats the tyrant Zahhak and divides the world among his three sons, a story beloved in Sogdian tradition.

figures.name: Khosrow I (Anushirvan)

ability.name: Just King
ability.description: Establish just rule; redistribute stats evenly among all allied cards.

figures.description: The Sasanian king of the golden age, renowned for justice and wisdom, whose reforms were celebrated in Sogdian-influenced traditions.

figures.name: Sogdian Griffin

ability.name: Treasure Guard
ability.description: Guard the Silk Road treasure; the next enemy resource theft is completely blocked and returned.

figures.description: The griffins depicted in Sogdian art protecting the wealth of merchants, supernatural guardians of the trade routes.

figures.name: Camel Caravan Spirit

ability.name: Long Journey
ability.description: Travel the Silk Road; draw 3 cards representing distant goods and knowledge.

figures.description: The spirit of the camel caravans that traversed the Silk Road, embodying the endurance and adventure of long-distance trade.

figures.name: Nanaï

ability.name: Lunar War Banner
ability.description: Raise the war banner under the moon; all allied cards in battle gain +3 power at night.

figures.description: The local Sogdian form of the goddess Nana, who appears on coins and frescoes as a warrior deity protecting the Sogdian city-states.

figures.name: Manichaean Elect

ability.name: Light Seed
ability.description: Plant light seeds in three enemy cards; they gradually convert to light alignment over 3 turns.

figures.description: The Manichaean religious elite who spread their faith along the Silk Road through Sogdia, embodying the cosmic battle of light against darkness.

figures.name: Alexander (Sogdian)

ability.name: World Conqueror
ability.description: Conquer any zone; gain control of one territory card from the opponent.

figures.description: Alexander the Great as experienced by the Sogdians, who fiercely resisted him and then influenced his culture, whose marriage to Roxana united east and west.

figures.name: Roxana

ability.name: East-West Bridge
ability.description: Unite opposing forces; cause two enemy cards to become allies instead of fighting each other.

figures.description: The Sogdian princess who married Alexander the Great, becoming a symbol of the cultural bridge between East and West on the Silk Road.
